title: Cultural Fairness Frameworks Comparison
description: Interactive matrix comparing how six cultural traditions (Western Liberal, Confucian, Ubuntu, Indigenous American, Islamic, Utilitarian) conceptualize fairness across five key dimensions: individual vs collective focus, process vs outcome emphasis, distribution principle, temporal scope, and scope of moral community.
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: ethics
fairness
cultural comparison
philosophy
justice
moral frameworks

pedagogicalMetadata.learningObjective: Students will be able to compare different cultural frameworks for understanding fairness
